2026Research software

MEHC-Curation — a framework for molecular data curation

MEHC-Curation is a Python framework for molecular dataset curation. This work reflects our interest in the quality and reproducibility of the data used in molecular modelling.

Read update ↗
2026Publication

A multimodal approach to molecular property prediction

Our published work explores a dual-attention multimodal framework for molecular property prediction. The study connects complementary molecular representations within a predictive modelling framework.
